name: Han Beo Deul
source:
Beo Deul is a freshman who’s active in the leadership team, his background is kept secret. He has earned the trust of the school teachers and is actually an honor student. However, the polite attitude that hides arrogance is strangely annoying.
[ Translator: [url=https://www.facebook.com/sophroniamoon888/]Sophronia Moon[/url] ]
